posts.text: I’m happy to share that I’m starting a new position as Senior Advisor at Human Milk Operations! After 14 whole months of full-funnel growth responsibilities, we rapidly weaned and retired the mother's milk in order to provide more flexibility to all parties involved.

A college friend who runs one of the top AI companies (you know of it, I promise) thinks we’re all playing Chutes and Ladders. He described our world as a board where one lucky spin carries you up a ladder and the next one can send you down a chute.
Can we talk about how whimsically refreshing this feature is on Tana? In the post meeting summary I got this cute card harkening to Friends vibes and an assist on logical next steps.

Something I’m really struggling with these days is what it even means for a team member or executive to do good work. For most of our careers, a polished deliverable was a pretty reliable sign that someone had done the thinking.

Jefferies found 10,000 young men became multi-millionaires at US AI firms. Ferrari identified them as its next customer base. When we automate everyday digital tasks, people look for tactile effort and curated physical judgment instead.
